text.tspan: So foolish. You are a child.
baka mitai kodomo na no ne
馬鹿みたい 子供なのね
Literal English translation
Romanji
Kanji
https://x.com/Memo_Foamcake/
Art by Memo_Foamcake
Stardust Infinity (SV2)
Baka Mitai
Went chasing a dream and got hurt.
yume o otte kizutsuite
夢を追って傷ついて
Even though you're bad at lies, -
uso ga heta na kuse ni
嘘が下手なくせに
- you showed me a humorless smile.
waraenai egao miseta
笑えない笑顔みせた
"I love you" is hardly ever said.
"I love you" mo roku ni iwani
"I love you" も ろくに言わない
Tongue-tied and downright self-conscious, -
kuchibeta de honma ni bukiyou
口下手でほんまに不器用
- But even so, even so, why is it "Goodbye" came so naturally?
na no ni na no ni doushite sayonara wa ieta no
なのになのにどうして サヨナラは言えたの
It's no use, no use, no use at all.
dame da ne dame yo dame na no yo
だめだね だめよ だめなのよ
It's no use, no use, no use at all.
dame da ne dame yo dame na no yo
だめだね だめよ だめなのよ
I love you, I love you far too much.
anta ga suki de sukisugite
あんたが 好きで好きすぎて
No matter how strong the drink, -
dore dake tsuyoi osake demo
どれだけ 強いお酒でも
- The memories don't fade - what a fool.
yugamanai omoide ga baka mitai
歪まない思い出が 馬鹿みたい
I love you, I love you far too much.
anta ga suki de sukisugite
あんたが 好きで好きすぎて
No matter how strong the drink, -
dore dake tsuyoi osake demo
どれだけ 強いお酒でも
- The memories don't fade - what a fool.
yugamanai omoide ga baka mitai
歪まない思い出が 馬鹿みたい
What a fool; honestly, what a fool.
baka mitai hontou baka ne
馬鹿みたい 本当バカね
Filled to the brim with faith in you.
anta shinjiru bakari de
あんた信じるばかりで
I play the part of the strong woman, -
tsuyoi onna no furi
強い女のふり
- And bathe in the suffocating night air.
setsunasa no yokaze abiru
切なさの夜風浴びる
Since I became alone, three years have passed.
hitori ni natte sannen ga sugi
一人になって ３年が過ぎ
Even the city streets have changed.
machinami sae mo kawarimashita
街並みさえも 変わりました
But even so, even so, why is it I'm still left behind in the past?
na no ni na no ni doushite miren dake okizari
なのになのにどうして 未練だけ置き去り
Really, you're a no-good man, no good at all.
honma ni roku na otoko ya nai
ほんまに ロクな男やない
My matching ring, I take it off.
soroi no yubiwa hazushimasu
揃いの指輪 はずします
Serves you right! I'm relieved.
zamaa miro seisei suru wa
ざまあみろ せいせいするわ
Really, you're a no-good man, no good at all.
honma ni roku na otoko ya nai
ほんまに ロクな男やない
My matching ring, I take it off.
soroi no yubiwa hazushimasu
揃いの指輪 はずします
Serves you right! I'm relieved.
zamaa miro seisei suru wa
ざまあみろ せいせいするわ
So then what are they, these tears - what a fool.
nan na yo kono namida baka mitai
なんなのよこの涙 馬鹿みたい
Yet naively I wait - what a fool.
ii kagen mattete mo baka mitai
いい加減 待ってても 馬鹿みたい
